patch.value: Catalog fleet discovery misidentifies sibling package worktrees as extension packages

In a worktree farm, catalog.test.ts and readFleetExtensions derive extension identity from sibling directory names. A sibling worktree shipping the pm-web host manifest is counted as an installable extension despite pm-web being excluded by design. Reproduce with a real directory named pm-web-candidate containing the host manifest. Resolve canonical package identity before using directory names; retain live-fleet completeness checks.
Fleet discovery resolves canonical package identity and a filesystem worktree fixture cannot appear as a separately named installable extension.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Baseline acceptance against the built package and a real scratch tracker: a directory named pm-web-candidate containing the actual host manifest and package metadata is returned as an extension with that directory name. Plan: derive identity from manifest name and matching package/repository metadata, exclude hosts by canonical identity, deduplicate equivalent worktrees, and reject unreadable or conflicting metadata. Add a real sibling git-worktree regression and make catalog assertions consume the shared derivation.
